material_omissions: No supplied evidence reports formal legal obligations, compliance findings, implementation failures, or independently evaluated implementation.
No dated evidence establishes current implementation or present-day continuation of the stated positions and activities.

notes: All propositions are unreviewed model candidates derived only from the supplied frozen corpus.
Program-level propositions use unresolved candidate scope because no durable program scope IDs were supplied.

evidence.quote: Driven by the imperative of climate justice, The Sunrise Project Australia's mission is to scale social movements

propositions.qualification: Mission statement recorded in an annual information statement.
propositions.value: Scale social movements to drive transition from fossil fuels to renewable energy as fast as possible.

evidence.quote: We worked to prevent the expansion of coal and gas mining

propositions.qualification: Activity and purpose description in the 2025 annual information statement.
propositions.value: Prevent expansion of coal and gas mining to protect Australia's natural environment and avoid dangerous climate change.

evidence.quote: We also supported efforts for Australian industry to decarbonise and scale renewable energy

propositions.qualification: Self-reported activity for the statement year.
propositions.value: Supported Australian industry decarbonisation and renewable-energy scaling efforts.

evidence.quote: We convene and contribute to international networks and coalitions focussed on solving the climate crisis

propositions.qualification: Description of international activity recorded in the annual information statement.
propositions.value: Convene and contribute to international climate networks and coalitions, provide overseas grant funding, commission research, and conduct online community education.

evidence.quote: We're changing that by building the collective power needed to phase out fossil fuels

propositions.qualification: Undated official website statement; present status is not established.
propositions.value: Build collective power to phase out fossil fuels and accelerate a fast, fair transition to renewable energy.

evidence.quote: We work to protect nature and the climate by opposing new fossil fuel developments

propositions.value: Oppose new fossil-fuel developments and support regions planning economic futures beyond coal and gas.

evidence.quote: We identify the pressure points that can shift the energy system

propositions.qualification: The website describes an operating approach, not verified implementation.
propositions.value: Identify pressure points in policy, finance, corporate decisions, and public debate, then organise networks to act.

evidence.quote: We fund organisations, and provide coaching and other forms of capacity building support.

propositions.value: Provide grantmaking, coaching, and other capacity-building support to organisations.

evidence.quote: a charitable purpose to protect the environment and prevent dangerous climate change

propositions.qualification: Official website description of charitable purpose; not a legal determination.
propositions.value: Protect the environment and prevent dangerous climate change.
